name: 陳怡倩
objective: This course introduces students to the practical use of artificial intelligence (AI) for cross-disciplinary data analysis and presentation. Students will learn how to leverage AI tools to collect, analyze, visualize, interpret, and present data in professional and personal contexts. Emphasis is placed on hands-on projects, ethical considerations, and translating AI outputs into actionable insights.

Week 2 AI tools Overview
Week 3 AI tools: Visualization I
Week 4 AI tools: Visualization II
Week 5 AI tools: Visualization III
Week 6 AI tools: Visualization IV
Week 7 (no class on Monday) Mini individual presentations I

Week 11 AI tools: Natural Language Processing III

Week 13 AI in Workflow Automation, Personal Productivity, Task Management I
Week 14 AI in Workflow Automation, Personal Productivity, Task Management II
Week 15 AI in Workflow Automation, Personal Productivity, Task Management III
Week 16 Mini individual presentation III
Week 17 Final Project Presentations I
Week 18 Final Project Presentations II
scorePolicy: Class participation (15%), class activities & mini-projects 60%), final project (25%)
consultation: Booking office hour appointment through e-mail at icchen@ntut.edu.tw
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG4：優質教育（Quality Education）SDG8：尊嚴就業與經濟發展（Decent Work and Economic Growth）SDG10：減少不平等（Reduced Inequalities）
課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）● 鼓勵學生使用生成式 AI 工具（Encourage students to use generative AI tools）● 簡單介紹 AI 的基本概念（Briefly introduce the basic concept of AI）● 深入探討 AI 的原理與應用（Explore the principles and applications of AI in depth）
